defects.description: A client-controlled request header (X-Internal-Role) is trusted as an authorization signal -- any caller who can reach the endpoint can set this header themselves.

The "internal network isolation" assumption the header check relies on is false: api-service is configured `public: true`, so the admin route is directly reachable from the public internet, not just from internal callers.
No validation on orderId/amount before processRefund -- once the auth bypass is exploited, the caller controls an arbitrary refund amount for an arbitrary order.
